title: Herdling gets a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on the eShop (Nintendo Everything report)

sources.note: Nintendo Everything 11 Nov 2026: 'A new Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Herdling has just been released'; may take a day or so to show in some regions; promises improved resolution, enhanced detail and enhanced performance; developer Okomotive, publisher Panic; no price
Big-N also reports it available on the eShop (via search)
Steam appdetails: developer Okomotive, publisher Panic, released 21 Aug 2025, Arabic in supported languages, 67.50 AED; official Gameplay Trailer used as footage

first_report: 2026-11-11 (Nintendo Everything, about 4 hours before the digest of 19:27 Dubai); not yet in Arabic outlets
gate: gate 00:35Z: Nintendo Everything read in full; Big-N second outlet; Nintendo eShop page not reachable (store product URL 404); no denial found in search; digest 23:48 Dubai shows no change

angle.hook: the cat-cow herding adventure Herdling now has a dedicated Switch 2 Edition on the eShop, reported by Nintendo Everything
angle.why_now: Nintendo Everything reported the edition went live on the eShop on 11 Nov, regional rollout still under way over the next day, and the Arabic press has not carried it yet
angle.what_it_means_here: Switch 1 and Switch 2 players in the Gulf may find it in the eShop as it rolls out, the price is not stated by the outlet, and the Steam version supports Arabic
angle.payoff: better resolution and performance are promised, price unconfirmed, Arabic support is confirmed only on Steam

story_items.report: finding: Switch 2 Edition released on eShop; evidence: Nintendo Everything and Big-N; limits: no price, no Nintendo or Panic page read, rollout by region

footage: Steam official Gameplay Trailer, app 3047750, clean continuous stretch 42.97 to 62.0 s (shotpick), trailer own sound
